subject: Partner voucher orchestration — CloudReach pilot grant request
messages:
From: Elena Kostova <elena.k@cloudreach.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Halvorsen <tom.h@cloudreach-partners.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: pilot marketplace grant for fintech accelerator cohort

Hi Mina,

Hope you’re well. We’re curating an EU fintech accelerator cohort for October and have two promising teams that would benefit from Redwood credits to run inference-heavy POCs (LLM-powered underwriting and real-time scoring). Can CloudReach request a small marketplace voucher for each team (roughly $5k USD equivalent), to be applied at listing activation?

I attached a short intake form and a one-pager on the accelerator. We can present the go-to-market plan and expected ARR uplift if that helps with approvals.

Quick ask: can we get a tentative answer by end of next week? Accelerator applications close 9/1.

Attachments: cloudreach_voucher_request.pdf (PDF, 220KB)

Thanks — Elena
Head of Partnerships, CloudReach

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: pilot marketplace grant for fintech accelerator cohort

Ben / Marissa — forwarding CloudReach's ask. TL;DR: two $5k-equivalent marketplace vouchers for EU accelerator teams, pilot marketing + co-sell commitment, timeline tight (need answer by 2026-08-21).

Questions:
- Ben: do we have budget in Q3 partner promotions for reseller-sourced grants?
- Marissa: marketplace ops / listing activation workflow — can we ensure vouchers are issued and limited to specific org IDs and use-by dates?

I attached their intake form. If we're comfortable, I can propose a conditional approval to Elena pending a signed MOP (mutual operating plan) and a follow-up quarterly check-in.

Mina
Partner Sales, Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: pilot marketplace grant for fintech accelerator cohort

Thanks for the ping, Mina.

We have a small partner promotions pool for Q3 earmarked for marketplace co-sell. Two $5k vouchers (total $10k) is within reason, but I need a short mutual action plan and a commitment on co-marketing (webinar / case study + pipeline milestone) before I greenlight.

Operational notes: Marketplace vouchers should be issued as restricted listing credits tied to the partner listing and expire in 90 days. Finance needs an invoice reference when consumed.

Marissa — will you confirm the mechanism to bind voucher to org ID and ensure single-use enforcement? If it's cleaner, we can use the standard RDW market voucher template; I put a draft in the attachments.

Ben
Director, GTM Partnerships
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: pilot marketplace grant for fintech accelerator cohort

All — we can do org-bound, single-use vouchers. Process: generate voucher code -> associate with partner listing -> set TTL and consumption rules -> finance tie via invoice id. I’ve tagged Marketplace Ops and Legal for a quick doc signoff on the MOP template.

One operational ask: Elena, when you confirm the two org IDs (or marketplace account emails) we’ll reserve codes but only activate after we receive a signed MOP and the partner signs the marketplace terms. Can you also confirm if teams are non-production POCs only? If they expect to go to prod, we'll need an SSO/data-processing review (customer-engagement).

Attachment: rdw_marketplace_voucher_template.pdf (PDF, 110KB)

-Marissa
Sr. Partner Ops Manager

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Kostova <elena.k@cloudreach.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 13 Aug 2026 09:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: pilot marketplace grant for fintech accelerator cohort — conditional approval

Hi Elena,

Good news — we can provisionally approve two marketplace vouchers (each $5k value) for the accelerator cohort on the conditions below: 1) CloudReach signs the attached MOP and marketplace terms, 2) vouchers are redeemed by the two named accelerator teams within 90 days of issuance, and 3) CloudReach commits to a co-marketing webinar and a short case study within Q1 post-pilot.

Next steps:
- I’ve attached an RDW MOP template and a voucher template. Please review, confirm the two marketplace account emails (or org IDs), and return the signed MOP via DocuSign.
- Once we receive the signed MOP, Marissa will reserve voucher codes and Finance will note the promo as RDW-3741.

Attachments: rdw_marketplace_voucher_template.pdf, cloudreach_voucher_request.pdf

Thanks — looking forward to working with you on this.

Mina Haddad
Partner Sales, Redwood Inference

From: Elena Kostova <elena.k@cloudreach.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Halvorsen <tom.h@cloudreach-partners.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Aug 2026 17:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: pilot marketplace grant for fintech accelerator cohort — signed MOP attached

Thanks, Mina — we’ve reviewed and signed the MOP via DocuSign. The two accelerator teams will use these marketplace accounts: team-alpha@finstart.org and team-aurora@finstart.org. Both teams are POC-only for October, with potential production later next year.

I attached the signed MOP (signed_partner_mop.pdf). Please confirm voucher reservation and expected issuance timeline. We’re excited to include Redwood in the accelerator showcase.

Attachments: signed_partner_mop.pdf (PDF, 95KB)

Best,
Elena
Head of Partnerships, CloudReach
